name: data-display/code-panel
title: Code panel
description: Highlighted source with line numbers and copy.

files.content:
export { CodePanel } from './CodePanel';
export type { CodePanelProps } from './CodePanel';

keyboard.action: Move to the copy button, then into the code area.

notes: The scrolling code area is focusable, so keyboard users can scroll it (axe rule scrollable-region-focusable).
Line numbers are generated by CSS and are not copied or read out.
The copy button’s visible label is its name and changes to “Copied” after a copy; the change is also announced.
Every token colour reaches at least 5:1 against the panel in both themes.
